# Forward Projection — Election Cycle Fixture

## Electoral Cycle Scenario Map (to 2029 Election)

**Baseline trajectory (50 %):** EPP-S&D-Renew centrist coalition navigates EP10 intact and translates to comparable EP2029 parliamentary arithmetic. Von der Leyen succession follows orderly Spitzenkandidaten process.

**Coalition fracture scenario (30 %):** Renew seat erosion in EP2029 breaks three-way centrist majority below 361-seat threshold. EPP pivots to selective ECR engagement on specific legislative files — new majority architecture emerges.

**Transformative election scenario (20 %):** Anti-establishment wave across 3+ large member states delivers Far-right bloc near blocking-minority status (≈220 seats). New grand coalition (EPP+S&D+Greens+Renew) required — German-style "traffic light" architecture at EP level.

## Key Electoral Cycle Milestones

- **2026**: EU budget mid-term review — political salience test for current coalition.
- **2027**: National election cycles in France, Germany, and Poland — bellwether for EP2029.
- **2028 H2**: EP campaign launch; Commission Work Programme wind-down; legislative pipeline acceleration.
- **2029 June**: European Parliament elections.
